title: LUMEN
description: The AI Workflow Playbook landing page featuring real-time optical glassmorphism, interactive workflow choreography, and custom shader studio.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js · Tailwind v4 · GSAP

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: Minimal sticky bar with LUMEN tracking mark, anchor navigation (Workspace, Playbook Preview, How It Works, FAQ, Glass Studio), and primary CTA.

sections.title: Hero (The Glass AI Workspace)
sections.summary: Value proposition, email capture form with validation and cooldown protection, unboxed metadata badges, optical scene switcher, and interactive 2.5D perspective workspace stage with stepped demonstration.

sections.title: Trusted By
sections.summary: Clean monochrome marks of forward-thinking teams using structured workflows.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.summary: 4 tangible pain points (email triage, meeting synthesis, unstructured document processing, fragmentation) with interactive impact details.

sections.title: Benefits
sections.summary: 3 core pillars (Practical Frameworks, Real Worked Examples, Reusable Prompts) with interactive scenario drilldowns.

sections.title: Inside the Playbook
sections.summary: Interactive 3-card 2.5D document stack previewing sample pages with tabbed navigation and 16-page outline modal.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.summary: 3-step operational progression (Identify Tasks, Design Workflow with Human Review Gates, Run & Refine).

sections.title: Practical Credibility
sections.summary: Framework comparison table and methodology pillars highlighting reliability, security, and human-in-the-loop validation.

sections.title: FAQ
sections.summary: Accordion covering formats, prerequisites, privacy, team rollout, and updates.

sections.title: Final Download CTA
sections.summary: High-conversion conversion card with secondary email capture.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: Animate an image-derived 3D glass relief mesh made from the AI-generated artwork, layered over the continuous page atmosphere with drifting light particles and glassy water drops. Particles and drops react to pointer movement; tapping or clicking the artwork releases a brief droplet burst and ripple. The mesh has estimated depth, the original image texture, and scroll-responsive drift; show the transparent image for reduced motion or unavailable WebGL. Include a closing playbook link, section navigation, studio link, and oversized LUMEN wordmark.
